CNAssetInfo.doc: An object that provides Cinematic-specific information about an asset, including its tracks.

CNBoundsPrediction.doc: A structure representing the bounds of the predicted subject.

CNCompositionInfo.doc: An object that enables you to add the appropriate number of tracks for a Cinematic asset.

CNCustomDetectionTrack.doc: An object representing a discrete detection track composed of individual detections.

CNDecision.doc: An object that represents a decision to focus on a particular detection, or group of detections, at a particular time.

CNDetection.doc: A structure that represents a detected subject, face, torso or pet at a particular time.

CNDetectionTrack.doc: An object representing a series of detections of the same subject over time.

CNFixedDetectionTrack.doc: An object representing the fixed detection track.

CNObjectTracker.doc: An object that converts a normalized point or rectangle into a detection track that tracks an object over time.

CNRenderingSession.doc: An object representing the context in which rendering occurs.

CNRenderingSessionAttributes.doc: A structure for movie-wide attributes required for proper rendering.

CNRenderingSessionFrameAttributes.doc: Creates an object with the per frame attributes that control the appearance of a single frame of the Cinematic movie.

CNScript.doc: A collection of focus decisions, focus transitions, detections, and detection tracks associated with a movie captured in Cinematic mode and methods to change them.

CNScriptChanges.doc: An object that represents a snapshot of the changes made to a movie script, including the added user decisions and detection tracks.

CNScriptFrame.doc: An object that represents what to focus on, and where to focus, in a given movie frame.

CNDetectionType.doc: The type of object detected, such as face, torso, cat, dog and so on.

CNRenderingQuality.doc: The rendering quality, such as thumbnail, preview, export and so on.

CNSpatialAudioContentTypeSpatial.doc: Export settings to generate an asset with spatial audio and effect burned in

CNSpatialAudioContentTypeStereo.doc: Export settings to generate an asset with stereo audio and effect burned in

CNSpatialAudioRenderingStyleCinematic.doc: Isolates the ambience and place it in a spatial stem. Isolates all voices and place them in a mono stem.

CNSpatialAudioRenderingStyleCinematicBac.doc: Isolates the ambience when foreground is cinematic Audio Mix and place it in a spatial stem. There is no voice stem.

CNSpatialAudioRenderingStyleCinematicFor.doc: Isolates all voices and places them in a mono stem. There is no ambience stem.

CNSpatialAudioRenderingStyleInFrame.doc: Isolates the ambience and place it in a spatial stem. Isolates only voices from the camera field of view and place them in a mono stem.

CNSpatialAudioRenderingStyleInFrameBackg.doc: Isolates the ambience and foreground that is out of frame and place it in a spatial stem. There is no voice stem.

CNSpatialAudioRenderingStyleInFrameForeg.doc: Isolates only voices from the camera field of view and place them in a mono stem. There is no ambience stem.

CNSpatialAudioRenderingStyleStandard.doc: This produces a spatial stem of the original recording that is unprocessed. This is the default rendering style.

CNSpatialAudioRenderingStyleStudio.doc: Isolates the ambience and place it in a spatial stem. Isolates all voices, add a studio/proximity effect in the voice track and place them in a mono stem.

CNSpatialAudioRenderingStyleStudioBackgr.doc: Isolates the ambience when foreground is studio Audio Mix and place it in a spatial stem. There is no voice stem.

CNSpatialAudioRenderingStyleStudioForegr.doc: Isolates all voices, add a studio/proximity effect in the voice track and place them in a mono stem. There is no ambience stem.

+loadFromAsset:completionHandler:.doc: Loads the rendering session attributes from an asset asynchronously.

-initWithSampleBuffer:sessionAttributes:.doc: Initializes the rendering frame attributes from a sample buffer read from a Cinematic metadata track.

-initWithTimedMetadataGroup:sessionAttri.doc: Initializes the rendering frame attributes from a timed metadata group read from a Cinematic metadata track.

-initWithDataRepresentation:.doc: Creates a previously saved data representation.

-bestDetectionForGroupID:.doc: The best detection to focus on in a frame among those within the given detection group.

-detectionForID:.doc: The detection in the frame with the given detection ID, if any.

renderingVersion.doc: The primary version number used to render the original Cinematic move that determines compatibility.

fNumber.doc: The f-stop value that inversely affects the aperture used to render the Cinematic image.

focusDisparity.doc: Represents the focus plane at which the rendered image should be in focus.

addedDetectionTracks.doc: All detection tracks added since recording the movie.

dataRepresentation.doc: Persistent data representation of changes for later restoration.

fNumber.doc: The f-stop number to apply to the entire movie.

userDecisions.doc: All active user decisions, including those made at recording time, unless removed.

allDetections.doc: All detections for the Cinematic movie.

focusDetection.doc: What to focus on in a given frame of the movie.

focusDisparity.doc: Where to focus in a given frame of the movie.

time.doc: The time of the focus transition.
